scope: Knoy-only inspection and evidence/visualization improvements after the independent R12 grade. No saved building geometry or master/shared files changed.
review_findings_addressed: R12 requested clearer floor-wide interior views where the 2018 plan supports them.
R12 requested a more legible spatial presentation of the source-located stair proxies.
R12 requested source-backed facade improvement without invented facade cadence/material assignments.

supports: red/brown brick at entrance sign wall
does_not_support: facade orientation fit from this image alone

archive_record.title: Knoy Hall of Technology records, UA 141
archive_record.repository: Purdue University Archives and Special Collections
archive_record.recorded_content: The collection description says it contains construction information and a floorplan; one folder, dated 1984, is listed as open for research.
archive_record.availability_limit: The online finding aid does not expose a downloadable scan or measured elevation. No archive contents were treated as inspected evidence.

planning_elevation_sheet.source: Purdue Engineering and Polytechnic Gateway Formation Study, 2018-05-31, PDF page 24
planning_elevation_sheet.finding: The supplied Existing Knoy Elevations area contains floor-datum/dimension lines, not a traceable facade drawing or fenestration schedule. Thus cadence and face materials remain unresolved.

facade_sources_and_limits.render_method: The saved source blend was reopened and rendered with its procedural brick/glazing materials; the blend was not saved by the render task. This is a visual comparison, not photogrammetric alignment.

circulation_and_interior_visuals.source: Purdue Gateway Formation Study page 24, Typical Plan Levels 2-4
circulation_and_interior_visuals.registration: Existing manually registered raster-to-local affine, approximately +/-1 m; no survey control
circulation_and_interior_visuals.interpretation: Full-floor views show the plan-traced partitions together with 15 selected plan-visible door leaves, three stair proxy footprints and 13 symbol-interpreted fixture proxies on each typical level. The isolated L2-L3 profile makes one modeled switchback proxy legible; stair geometry is illustrative, and this is not proof of an as-built or complete route.
nonclaims: no basement/L1/L5/roof stair connection is asserted
no code or accessibility clearance is asserted
render colors are temporary audit coding, not actual finishes
no room use beyond source-supported plan symbols is asserted

remaining_uncertainties: Full facade cadence and exact material mapping require measured/current elevations or calibrated orthogonal photos.
Purdue Archive UA 141 contents are not available as scanned files in the public online finding aid.
L5, roof, penthouse and conflicting GIS 48-ft extrusion semantics remain unresolved.
Only L2-L3 and L3-L4 stair proxy intervals are modeled; their section dimensions are estimates, and no continuous route outside these intervals is verified.
The floorplan itself is a 2018 planning raster, not a current measured as-built architectural drawing.
